description: Upstream license texts for Ghostty Zig packages whose fetched tree has no license file. scripts/collect-ghostty-licenses.py ships these files from the repository, checks each SHA-256, and never downloads them. Each upstream URL is immutable (a commit, a content-addressed archive, or an archived snapshot). To change a file: copy it byte for byte from its upstream, update its sha256 here, update PINNED_MANIFEST_SHA256 in the collector, and record the review in NOTICES-REVIEW-LEDGER.md.
